description.en: A standardized benchmark for generating pathology reports from whole-slide images. It covers TCGA, HistAI and REG 2025 with three foundation encoders and scores reports with the Clinical Report Quality Score (CRQS).

claire_radar.motivation: Pathology report generation from whole-slide images (WSIs) is a rapidly growing multimodal learning problem, yet progress is difficult to measure because existing studies use heterogeneous datasets, model settings, visual encoders, and evaluation protocols.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Lexical metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE can miss clinically important errors. PathReportEval standardizes the evaluation pipeline and adds a clinically grounded score for factual correctness, which makes pathology report generation models easier to compare.
